fields.note: No day exists for 2026-27: that season's infobox reads 'dates = 31 July 2026 – 2027' (year only) and hy.wikipedia has no 2026-27 season article (search returns only World Cup qualifiers), while the FFA site (premierleague.ffa.am/hy/games) publishes only the current round. Value is a proxy: the league's own previous season ended 27 May 2026.

ARM2 (second tier, Armenian First League) carries ARM1's window via 'inherited_from', so the quoted infobox is the Premier League's, not the First League's. There is no '2026-27 Armenian First League' (or 2025-26) article on en.wikipedia and no First League date on the FFA site, so no day exists. Proxying from the Premier League would be another league, which the rules forbid.
